svg.text: Sculpting the β-carbon: the reductive loop
After each KS condensation makes a β-keto thioester, optional KR → DH → ER domains reduce it. How many act sets the group left in the chain.
No reductive domains → ketone · +KR → hydroxyl (the –OH groups of erythromycin)
+KR+DH → alkene (C=C) · +KR+DH+ER → fully saturated chain (fatty-acid-like) — one logic, many scaffolds.
